entities.summary: Ho Ching (Chinese: 何晶; pinyin: Hé Jīng; Wade–Giles: Ho2 Ching1; Cantonese Yale: Hòh Jīng; born 27 March 1954) is a Singaporean businesswoman. Ho Ching was a performers & entertainers from Colony of Singapore (b. 1953-05-01, Colony of Singapore). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
